Hot Topic Ideator 1.0.0

- Initial release of “热点选题生成器” for 小红书 content ideation.
- Delivers 5–10 hot topic ideas for brands based on real data, output as a professional HTML report (convertible to PDF).
- Follows a standardized, step-by-step workflow: brand info collection, keyword generation, note search & analysis, topic mining, trend validation, detailed report generation.
- Strict design and output standards: Tailwind CSS, single-file HTML, high information density, professional visual style, and no use of external images or complex CSS visualizations.
- Includes comprehensive error handling and fallback strategies for insufficient data or API failures.
